_provenance.gate_c_split: Installed under validator gate (c'), added 2026-08-09: a folded spelling that has its OWN address in target_symbol_map.json, different from the survivor's, is a DISTINCT FUNCTION the transitive closure merged in error, and is dropped FROM the class instead of rejecting the class whole. This retires `known_regression_vs_76_class_set`: all five MakeString names the 76 -> 368 growth had lost are back. Measured on this tree, 368 -> 371 classes, 2,097 -> 2,121 names, and strict raw_text_reloc_eq passes 18,061 -> 18,234.
_provenance.onlyreturns_class: Added 2026-08-10. `OnlyReturns` is the splitter's name for the address every trivially-returning function folded into. The 12 members are the definitions of ours whose body sha equals that folded body; seven other names pair with the same address with DIFFERENT bodies and are deliberately excluded -- notably ??1CriticalSection@@QAA@XZ, 9 functions, which is a mismatch to fix and not a fold to declare.
_provenance.weak_alias_classes: Added 2026-08-10. MSVC emits the vector deleting destructor ??_E<Class> as an UNDEFINED WEAK EXTERNAL whose auxiliary record names its default resolution ??_G<Class> with characteristics 2 (IMAGE_WEAK_EXTERN_SEARCH_ALIAS). The linker resolves one to the other, so these are declared aliases, not empirical folds -- the compiler states it in our own object file. Direction is read off the target: whichever spelling the target objects define is the survivor (893 ??_G, 78 ??_E), because gate (c) requires exactly that.
